description: Control and simulate robots in NVIDIA Isaac Sim through Viam

models.short_description: Boots and manages the Isaac Sim world/stage. Configure exactly one.
Signals that scene population is complete; depends_on every sim component
A simulated arm (UR, Franka, or any articulation USD)
A simulated RGB camera in the Isaac Sim stage
A simulated parallel-jaw gripper (Robotiq 2F-85) attached to a simulated arm
A simulated vacuum gripper that welds a box to its cup, bolted to a simulated arm
Color-sorts blocks onto per-color pads via DoCommand start/stop/status: N loops or continuous
Proxies a conductor's status for data management, emitting each new loop record at most once
Picks a box from the infeed and places it on a pallet slot via DoCommand start/stop/status
